page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head above the text; page number at the top; a gathering signature and catchword at the foot. Left-margin edge fragments of the neighbouring page are not transcribed. Greek words in the text are transcribed in Greek letters where legible.
page.running_head: Lib.5. De specialib. in politeia divina.

main_text.p: est, vt Deo tantum corda probanti placere studentes, aliis omnibus etiam vita & salute sua supra omnia ex ministerio, dei gloria in electiorum vocatione, reproborum obduratione quærant. Rom. 9.2.3.4. &c. 1.Cor.4.2.3.4.5.6. 1.Cor.3.14.15.16.17. Galat. 1.10. 1. Thess.2.3.4.5.6.7.
Fructus perceptio, vt ea obtinendi certa fiducia acquiescant. 1.Thess.2.12.20.

p.i: Atqz hæc sunt specialia ad dignitatem: Sequuntur ad ἐκκλησίας.

main_text.p: Ea autem sunt, ea spiritualia charismata quæ cuique præfecturæ sunt idonea. Rom.12. 5. 6. 7.Iob. 31. 23. 24. Gene. 6. 9. 11. 12. cum 1.Pet. 3. 19. 4.6. Levit.10.10.Ierem.1.6.7. Hose.4.6.Mal.2.4.5.6.7. Luc. 24.49. 1.Pet.4.11.
Prophetia, est omnia ad dei cultū publicum administrare. Iob.33.23.24.1.Chron.25.1.3.Rom.12.5.6. 1. Thess.5.20.
Eius partes sunt: Publicæ preces. Iob.33.23. 24. Gene. 13.4.Ge.35.2.6.7.Ge. 14.18.19.20.Deut.33.10. 1.Sam.12.25.Act.6.1.2.
Publicæ preces, sunt preces conceptæ ad communem & specialem omnium cultum divinum exercentium utilitatem & intelligentiam. Iob. 34. 25. Neh.8.7. 1.Cor.14.13.14.16.17.

page.notes: Marginal note on left edge ("Verbi" catchword at foot). Greek phrase "ἐκκλησίας" is a reading of the printed "ixavotyta" and is uncertain. Right-hand braces group Prophetia/Diaconia and Publicæ preces/Verbi prædicatio; the brace text is transcribed in running order.
